site.title: QuirkBox - Random Name Generator, Pixel Avatar Maker & More Fun Tools
site.description: A playful collection of tiny tools with a random foreign name generator, a pixel avatar maker, and room for more experiments.

home.title: Random names and pixel avatars, generated in your browser.

tools.title: Tool collection
tools.description: Tiny browser-based generators for random names and pixel avatars.

about.title: About QuirkBox
about.description: A small playground of fast, shareable generators.

randomName.title: Random Name Generator
randomName.description: Pick a language and get a full name with a surname, written in its native script and read out loud by your browser.

pixelAvatar.title: Pixel Avatar Maker
pixelAvatar.description: Pick a pixel-art style, then grow a one-of-a-kind avatar from a shareable seed and export it as a PNG.
pixelAvatar.styleHint: Each style has its own pixel density and level of detail.
pixelAvatar.seedHint: Keep the same seed to recreate the exact same avatar.

emojiWallpaper.title: Emoji Wallpaper Maker
emojiWallpaper.description: Tile a set of emoji into a phone wallpaper, pick the emoji, the arrangement and the aspect ratio, then export it at 4K.
emojiWallpaper.themeHint: Each set is a themed pile of emoji to tile with.
emojiWallpaper.emojiHint: Pick your own emoji to override the set. Up to 12; leave empty to use the set above.
emojiWallpaper.patternHint: How the emoji are laid out across the canvas.
emojiWallpaper.ratioHint: Every ratio exports at 4K or larger on the short edge.
emojiWallpaper.columnsHint: How many emoji fit across. Fewer means bigger emoji.
emojiWallpaper.seedHint: Keep the same seed to recreate the exact same wallpaper.
